contentText: In tonight's edition, the US puts a pause on the processing of permanent residency visas for applicants from 75 countries, including 26 African ones. Also, Nigerian police walk back on earlier denials, NOW confirming that dozens of worshippers were kidnapped from three churches in northern Kaduna over the weekend. And in Kenya, a team of trained female motorcycle riders and nurses are helping expectant mothers reach clinics and hospitals faster.
